paper_title: Wideband Search for Axionlike Dark Matter Using Octupolar Nuclei in a Crystal
coupling_convention: ALP-gluon coupling strength C_G/f_a in GeV^-1, exactly as plotted on the y-axis of FIG. 4 (NOT converted to d_n in e*cm)
notes: Paper reports a new 95% CL exclusion on the ALP-gluon coupling C_G/f_a (GeV^-1) from an oscillating 153Eu nuclear Schiff moment search in Eu:YSO, spanning m_a ~ 5e-21 to 2e-12 eV (1.3 uHz - 500 Hz). No numerical table is provided; data_points are order-of-magnitude reconstructions derived from the reported theta_0 sensitivity (Fig. 5a, noise floor 1.6e-8 Hz^2, f_d = 6.7 kHz * theta) converted via C_G/f_a = theta_0 * m_a / sqrt(2*rho_DM) with rho_DM = 0.4 GeV/cm^3, including the reported stochastic correction (up to 3.9x for m_a <~ 1e-14 eV) and high-frequency (>100 Hz) sensitivity loss. Values should be replaced by the digitized Fig. 4 curve or the Zenodo dataset (10.5281/zenodo.18879939) for precision. Coupling type set to AxionEDM per pre-analysis hint since the enum lacks a dedicated gluon-coupling category, but emitted values are raw C_G/f_a in GeV^-1, NOT d_n in e*cm - downstream conversion required.
